coverage_scope: Finite-panel empirical validation of the coverage target on fresh draws from the Gaussian model. For R>=2, the bootstrap uses an internal 0.04 threshold against a 95% hull-coverage target; R1 uses a separately justified 95% upper limit. Fitted-nuisance bootstrap and continuous-parameter interpolation remain approximate, with no exact continuum guarantee.
